run_process_s3_logs: run the script to collect S3 logs from Turk and postprocess them into collated CSV outputs
run_read_s3_bucket: run read_s3_bucket to extract logs.tar.gz archives from a local S3-synced directory into an output directory
run_read_turk_logs: run read_turk_logs to crawl pipe-delimited CSV files, add turk_log_id columns, and concatenate them into a single output CSV
refactor_read_s3_bucket: refactor read_s3_bucket to use a configurable regex pattern instead of the hardcoded turk_interactions_with_agent path
refactor_read_turk_logs: refactor read_turk_logs to apply drop_duplicates in place instead of discarding the returned DataFrame
